vectors.description: selection is a strict object over an enum of admitted fields
denied fields are removed from the admitted set
a denial that empties the set renders z.array(z.never())
an empty admitted set renders z.array(z.never())
non-identifier field names are JSON-escaped literals
a non-binary admitted field is a typed error
a non-binary denied field is a typed error
relationships nest as a load key
